FN-JA2WYF-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 208
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Randy Price
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/17/2023
Senate Bill 208 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Medicaid Agency
program and the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) by an undetermined amount for
transplant services, dependent on the number of eligible recipients with disabilities who would
have otherwise not received transplant services.
The average Medicaid-funded transplant costs in the range of $330,000 to $370,000 with the
state share funded by UAB.
